text:
**Parkvale Hockey Club Committee Meeting, 30 Sept 2026**

Thank you all for attending this committee meeting on 30 September 2026. The main outcomes are set out below, beginning with the key decision.

**Key decision:** The committee has agreed that, for 2027, senior registration fees will rise by $40, from their current level to $340. By contrast, junior fees will remain at $180. This decision was made in light of the fact that junior numbers fell by 18 last season, which was mostly due to cost. The rise in senior fees is intended to cover a 9% increase in council turf hire. The motion was carried 5-0.

**Finances:** To turn to the club's financial position, the cash balance currently stands at $41,820. Holding junior fees at their current level leaves a projected shortfall of about $3,200. To address this, Bryce will kindly apply for a council grant to cover the shortfall. Please note that the grant application closes on 14 November.

**Actions:** The following actions were agreed upon at the meeting:

- Wes will obtain two quotes for repairing the leaking dugout roof and for replacing a north-side light globe.
- Presentation night will be held on Saturday 24 October at the bowling club, with tickets priced at $45. Natalie has kindly agreed to organise the trophies. Setup volunteers are needed from 4pm, so please let the committee know if you are able to help.
- The committee has approved the purchase of a new club gazebo, with a spending limit of up to $600.

**Next meeting:** The next committee meeting will take place on Wednesday 28 October. We look forward to seeing everyone there.
